title: The hosted bypass list omits the author-association gate
problem: The gate list omits the author-association pre-filter. `_review_skip_reason` rejects these bot payloads because their association is normally `NONE`. A successful inbox carve-out bypasses that result. The section names the other bypassed gates but does not state that provenance replaces this trust check. This incomplete contract can hide a security-sensitive bypass from future changes.
suggestion: Add the author-association pre-filter to this list. State that verified task provenance and the reviewer opt-in replace both human-author trust checks.
cluster_issue: AGENTS.md carve-out bypass enumeration omits the untrusted_author_association branch of _review_skip_reason
